requirements.title: IPARITY argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer array; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range 1 through the rank of ARRAY; MASK shall be logical and conformable with ARRAY.

pending.IPARITY-array-integer-array: Positive plan uses rank-one and rank-two integer arrays with nonzero elements; scalar or noninteger ARRAY mutation is source-control only with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IPARITY-dim-integer-scalar-valid-range: Positive plan uses DIM=1 and DIM=2 on a rank-two array with distinct shapes and bit results; out-of-range DIM mutation is source-control only.
pending.IPARITY-mask-logical-conformable: Positive plan uses a conformable logical MASK selecting a nonempty subset and an all-false zero-result companion; wrong-shape MASK mutation is source-control only.

requirements.title: IPARITY result has ARRAY type and kind and optional DIM shape
requirements.definition: The result has the same type and kind as ARRAY; it is scalar without DIM and otherwise has rank n-1 with the shape of ARRAY excluding dimension DIM.

pending.IPARITY-result-same-type-kind-as-array: Assign IPARITY([1,2,4]) through an integer sentinel initialized to -777 and assert KIND equals KIND of ARRAY's elements.
pending.IPARITY-result-scalar-without-dim: Use rank-two ARRAY with DIM absent, initialize scalar sentinel to -777, and assert the scalar bit pattern differs from DIM=1 and DIM=2 companions.
pending.IPARITY-result-rank-and-shape-with-dim: Use shape [2,3] ARRAY; assert SHAPE(IPARITY(ARRAY,DIM=1)) is [3] and SHAPE(IPARITY(ARRAY,DIM=2)) is [2], with value checks that fail under swapped DIM.

requirements.title: IPARITY without DIM returns bitwise exclusive OR of all elements and zero for size zero
requirements.definition: IPARITY(ARRAY) equals the bitwise exclusive OR of all elements of ARRAY; a zero-size ARRAY produces zero.

pending.IPARITY-all-elements-exclusive-or: Use ARRAY=[14,13,8,-1] and compute the expected bit pattern by a source-visible IEOR chain; compare IPARITY only with BTEST over all bit positions and mutate the reduction to IOR.
pending.IPARITY-zero-size-array-zero: Use an allocated zero-size integer array, initialize result sentinel to -777, assert POPCNT(IPARITY(array)) equals 0, and include nonempty companion [1,2,4] with nonzero POPCNT.

requirements.title: IPARITY with DIM reduces each vector section along the selected dimension
requirements.definition: For rank-one ARRAY the DIM form equals the no-DIM form; for higher rank, each result element equals IPARITY of the corresponding vector section along DIM, with the corresponding MASK section applied when MASK is present.

pending.IPARITY-rank-one-dim-equals-no-dim: Use rank-one ARRAY=[1,2,4] and compare IPARITY(ARRAY,DIM=1) with IPARITY(ARRAY) by BTEST after initializing separate sentinels.
pending.IPARITY-dim-vector-section-reduction: Use a 2 by 3 ARRAY with distinct low-bit patterns; assert DIM=1 produces three section XOR patterns and DIM=2 produces two different section XOR patterns, observed by BTEST.
pending.IPARITY-dim-mask-section-reduction: Use a conformable rank-two MASK that selects different elements in each vector section; compare each result element with IPARITY of the corresponding PACKed section and mutate MASK columns.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.106-16.9.112: IEOR, IMAGE_INDEX, IMAGE_STATUS, INDEX, INT, IOR and IPARITY (batch194). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; IMAGE_INDEX and the team/failed/stopped facets of IMAGE_STATUS are out of scope; INDEX covers the zero-length-substring results; the numeric value of a BOZ with its leftmost bit set under INT has no portable oracle. Source accounting only.
